user.title: Connect to SolarMatrix
user.description: Paste a SolarMatrix API key. Create one at {api_keys_url}.

pick.title: Choose a household
pick.description: Pick the household this integration should monitor. To monitor more households, add the integration again — use a different API key, or reduce polling frequency to avoid hitting the rate limit.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter API key
reauth_confirm.description: Your API key is no longer valid. Enter a new one to continue.

abort.no_systems: This API key has no SolarMatrix systems.
abort.no_households: No households are accessible with this API key.
abort.unknown_selection: Selected household is no longer available.
